titolo: Il SUV da 45.000 euro costa davvero 50.500 euro in 5 anni
protagonista: Marco, 42-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, wearing a navy polo shirt and beige chinos

copertina.sfondo: A shiny new mid-size gray SUV in front of an Italian apartment building, with a worried-looking man in a navy polo shirt and beige chinos standing beside it holding a stack of receipts

scene.voce: Marco compra un SUV nuovo. Quarantacinquemila euro, a rate. Sembra un affare. Ma quanto gli costa davvero tenerlo cinque anni?

sfondi.descr: Close-up of a price tag on the windshield of a new gray mid-size SUV in an Italian car dealership showroom
Marco, 42-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy polo shirt and beige chinos, shaking hands with a salesman at a car dealership next to a new gray SUV

scene.voce: Cinque anni di spese. Anticipo, rate e interessi: cinquantaduemila euro. Assicurazione: quattromilacinquecento. Carburante: settemilacinquecento. Manutenzione e gomme: quattromila. Bollo: millecinquecento. Parcheggi e pedaggi: tremila. Totale: settantaduemilacinquecento euro.

sfondi.descr: Bank loan contract and car financing papers with a pen and car keys on a wooden desk
Car insurance policy document and car keys on a kitchen table
Gas station in Italy with a fuel pump nozzle in a gray SUV's tank, price display visible
Auto repair shop with a gray SUV lifted on a hydraulic lift, tires leaning against the wall
Italian road tax payment slip (bollo auto) on a table next to a calculator
Paid street parking meter in an Italian city with a gray SUV parked nearby and a highway toll booth ticket on the dashboard

scene.voce: Intanto il SUV perde valore. Oggi vale quarantacinquemila euro. Dopo cinque anni, solo ventiduemila.

sfondi.descr: Brand new shiny gray mid-size SUV parked in front of an Italian apartment building, sunny day
The same gray SUV five years older, dusty with small scratches and dents, parked in front of the same Italian apartment building, overcast sky

scene.voce: Facciamo i conti. Hai speso settantaduemilacinquecento euro. Rivendi a ventiduemila. Il costo vero è cinquantamilacinquecento euro. Ogni mese: ottocentoquarantadue euro. Ogni giorno: ventotto euro.

sfondi.descr: Marco, 42-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy polo shirt and beige chinos, sitting at a kitchen table with a calculator, receipts and a notebook
Close-up of Marco, 42-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy polo shirt, with a shocked and stunned expression looking at a calculator
An empty open wallet next to a wall calendar on a kitchen table, a few coins scattered

scene.voce: Come spendere meno? Compra un'auto usata di due anni. Confronta le assicurazioni ogni anno. Scegli un'auto più piccola.

sfondi.descr: Marco, 42-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy polo shirt and beige chinos, looking at a used gray SUV at a used car lot in Italy
Laptop on a table showing an insurance price comparison website with several offers, next to a coffee cup
A small compact city car parked on a narrow Italian street next to a large SUV, sunny day

scene.voce: Nella prossima puntata: quanto costa davvero un cane?

sfondi.descr: A cute golden retriever puppy sitting in the living room of an Italian middle-class apartment, looking at the camera
